scope: source-only PairCoarsePixels exactness and CPU replay; no physics/video run
algorithm: For each exact raw JPEG, cache state-free 960x720 yellow component mask using keep[labels] with background excluded and <=300-pixel threshold unchanged. Cache beam feature by exact JPEG and reference lane by exact reference bytes plus slot. Cache sizes 4/4/8; return independent mutable copies. Per-instance wheel centers and all action thresholds unchanged.

regression.covered: exact 300/301-pixel component boundary, background, invalid JPEG and dimensions, changed raw bytes, cache eviction, returned-value mutation isolation, independent center state and parallel callers

cpu_replay.method: Read original 120 v9 TOP JPEGs in order, run old HEAD and current controllers with saved identity/reference; two slot decisions per frame, perf_counter wall timings; no physics

limitations: These are isolated CPU timings and exact saved-RGB behavior checks, not a new native mission result. v9 render_wait median was 0.1427 wall s and remains the major runtime cost; actual combined wall latency and SIM TTL/duty require v10 native replay.
